notes.title: Cyndefense 2 Update 2.0
notes.notes:
This is a big one.

I'll start off by announcing that the game is now free to play for everyone! If you don't own the game, now you can!

Now lets see what's changed.

+ 4 New Maps!
- Blizzard
- Sandstorm
- Sparkle Cave
- Nightmare
(Invalid Access)

+ New Features!
- You can now rotate the directional towers to the right by pressing E
- You can rotate directional towers to the left by pressing Q
- Multiple paths on some maps.
- Can input secret codes, via the musical crystals on Sparkle Cave, or simply create your own song(s) if you so choose.
- On Sandstorm the enemies cannot leave the map, instead you will lose compounding lives every 3 seconds. This means you will lose more lives each time you lose health, but the compound will reset each wave.

+ Changes!
- Mother of all Bombs was made MUCH more powerful and can now pierce 5 enemies before exploding into much more damage than before.
- The map "Monolith's Domain" is now available without having to complete Cyneration difficulty on each previous map.
- Minor visual tweaks and bug fixes with enemy pathing and tower placements.

notes.title: Cyndefense 2 Free
notes.notes:
It's been a few months since the release of Cyndefense 2 and I have decided to make the game free to play for everyone. And as thanks for those who have supported me and bought the game, it will receive one final update that improves game accessibility as well as adds a couple new maps to enjoy. This new update will also allow you to play the hidden map "Monolith's Domain" without having to complete Cyneration Difficulty on all previous maps.

Monolith's Domain: This map serves as the final map in the Cyndefense 2 storyline where you defeat the entity behind the Incyneration, Monolith. All enemies have drastically increased health and slightly increased speed on this map including bosses! So you MUST have a great understanding of each tower and their abilities in order to beat the map and defeat Monolith.

New feature! When the price changes to free, the update will be released allowing a new feature, for those who need, or want it for ease, will be able to change a tower's rotation once to the right with 'E' or once to the left with 'Q'. You can also press 'SPACEBAR' to start a new wave instead of having to click the play button each time.

New maps! Again, when the price is updated, not one, not two, not three, but FOUR new maps will be added to the game, each with their own design and their own song. This will bring a total of 12 maps to the game for everyone to play.

That's all I have for now! Thank you!

notes.title: Major Update Approaching
notes.notes:
Cyndefense 2 is going to have one last major update before I start working full time on other projects. Bug fix updates may still occur afterwards as bugs are discovered. The final update is going to add in a new map or 2 as well as some new controls for directional towers. No release date for this update yet, but the goal is to have it done before Christmas.

With that said, this is also the official announcement of Cyndefense 3: Incyneration :)

notes.title: Cyndefense 2 V1.2
notes.notes:
This is a patch update for Cyndefense 2 which aims to fix various bugs as well as adds in a couple new features to the game.

* Attempted a fix for endless waves where the towers would fire but no enemies would spawn. I could not replicate the bug myself but I edited the code that I believe caused the issue.
* Fixed some minor texture bugs and hit box bugs.
* Changed some graphics, such as the game logo.

+ Early game enemies now spawn with a random amount of health and movement speed. 
- This is balanced around the base health and speed that they used to have so that their max possible health cannot go much higher and the minimum health can go somewhat lower. This will overall decrease the difficulty of the early game, mostly useful for Cyneration difficulty.
+ Added a "Help" menu.
- This menu should describe details that are not normally known right away in game, acting as somewhat of a tutorial. If the game still seems confusing feel free to leave feedback as to what I should add to the "tutorial".
+ Added links to Vignition Stuidos twitter and YouTube accounts.

* Probably did some other stuff too balance related, but I don't remember what cause I don't write my changes down like I should. So uh, yeah. Nothing really noticeable though, the game still feels the same. It is definitely a little easier though.

notes.title: Cyndefense 2 Version 1.1
notes.notes:
This update just fixes a slight amount of bugs that I did not catch before launch. The biggest one being a little question mark box that appears when you have a tower selected. When hovering over said box it will show you the tower details and selling price of the tower (backspace to sell).

I encourage people to post reviews of the game along with feedback and potential bugs that may need fixing. Update ideas are welcome too!
